title: Repository State Observation
description: One forge observation of a repository: its default-branch head, compared with its latest audit when it was pushed since. Stored as the artifact of an assessment of kind repo-state on the observed head ref (baseline_assessment_id = the audit). Recorded only when the forge answered; an unreachable or quota-deferred observation is the run order's outcome, not a document. Repository-level facts (public, upstream, archived) live on the repository row; fork_of keeps the parent the forge reported, the evidence behind repository.upstream_id.

pushed_at.description: Last push the forge reported; drives dormancy and whether a comparison was due.

fork.description: Whether the forge calls this repository a fork; absent when it didn't say. false is the forge's answer that it isn't one, which an absent fork_of alone cannot tell from no answer.

fork_of.description: The repository this one forks, as the forge reported it (https URL); absent when it isn't a fork or the forge named no parent. The observation that brings an upstream into the inventory.

comparison.description: The head compared with the audited commit; absent when the repository was not pushed since the audit. The file counts (first_party_files, iac_files, threat_model_files, tree_first_party_files) and secret_hits are optional: observations recorded before they were measured lack them.

truncated.description: The forge capped the file list; line counts are a lower bound.

first_party_files.description: Changed files that count as first-party (vendored, generated and docs excluded): the numerator of the diff-refusal ratio.

iac_files.description: Changed first-party IaC files (Terraform, CloudFormation, ARM/Bicep): code the cloud-config lane assesses and a code audit does not.

threat_model_files.description: Changed first-party interface-bearing files (entry-point directories, main files, OpenAPI/Swagger, protobuf): new entry points or trust boundaries a threat model may miss.

tree_first_party_files.description: First-party files in the head's tree, counted only when enough first-party files changed for the diff-refusal ratio to matter; absent when not counted (no cheap listing on the forge, or the forge truncated the tree).

secret_hits.description: Secret-scanner (gitleaks) hits in the change's patch text, scanned during the observation: the router's tripwire. Absent when not scanned (no lines changed, no patch, or the scanner unavailable or failed).
